A <c:ffff00>support type<c> <c:ffff00>skill<c>: the ability to handle <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> that
protect allies from {{enemy}} <c:ffff00>attacks<c>. <c:ffff00>Actions<c> that
perform an <c:ffff00>{{interrupt_guard}}<c> belong to it.
The higher the <c:ffff00>{{skill_level}}<c>, the faster <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and
<c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> are, and the higher <c:ffff00>defense power<c> and
<c:ffff00>evasion power<c> become; defense power rises even
more during an {{interrupt_guard}}.
On Block {{part|pl}}, the <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> stat rises when the <c:ffff00>Charge<c>
<c:ffff00>Gauge<c> fills.
